review:
A 5x6 scatter-pays game with hammers, swords, mugs and Vikings. Eight or more matching symbols anywhere win and tumble.

Coins attach to symbols at random, holding money up to 20x or multipliers up to 10x – if a coin is part of a win, it goes into a meter that pays out at the end of the tumble sequence. That meter adds a second way to win every spin. Four scatters trigger the bonus. Up to 10,000x, 96.05% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
